subject.title: fix(ios): sync stale Apple localization catalog

question: Which current branch should be the canonical repair for the stale Apple localization catalog: this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110404?
rationale: The two branches are claimed to be duplicate generator output, but both are open, their current-head equality is unproven after a later force-push, and this PR has a protected maintainer label.
